build.versions: Docker Engine supplied by the ubuntu-24.04 and ubuntu-24.04-arm hosted images; node:24-alpine base pulled fresh by docker build --pull
build.route: Native amd64 and arm64 hosted machines build the image from file-hosting/ and push an architecture sha tag. No tests or lint.

publish.versions: Docker Buildx and jq supplied by the ubuntu-24.04 hosted image
publish.route: Joins the two architecture images under the commit sha tag; on main also the server version and latest. No tests or lint.
